界面、提示和命令行用的语言: Used for the app, notifications and the command line
复制链接时问我要不要下载: Ask to download when I copy a link
复制了视频链接、1 分钟内回到 Captae 时，在输入框上方问一句: When you copy a video link and come back to Captae within 1 minute, it asks above the link field
最多同时下载几个: How many to download at the same time
大文件分成几段同时下，网速好时更快: Downloads large files in several parts at once, faster on a good connection
按类型存到 影片 / 音乐 / 图片 › Captae: Saved by type to Movies / Music / Pictures › Captae
按类型存到 视频 / 音乐 / 图片 › Captae: Saved by type to Videos / Music / Pictures › Captae
先在「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 完全磁盘访问权限」里打开 Captae: First turn on Captae in “System Settings › Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access”
第一次读会弹出钥匙串授权，点「始终允许」: The first read shows a Keychain prompt: click “Always Allow”
Windows 上读不了：它给登录信息加了只有它自己能解开的加密。建议改读 Fi: Can't be read on Windows: it encrypts sign-ins so only it can decrypt them. Read Firefox instead
读的时候要先关掉这个浏览器，它开着时不让别的程序读: Close this browser first: it doesn't let other apps read its sign-ins while it's open
要用系统的密钥环（GNOME Keyring / KWallet）解密，密钥环锁: Decrypted with your system keyring (GNOME Keyring / KWallet). If the keyring is locked, you'll be asked to unlock it
这台电脑上存的登录状态已经删掉: The sign-in saved on this computer was deleted
在 Captae 里登录过的网站。登录状态只存在这台电脑上；AI 助手看不到，它: Sites you've signed in to in Captae. Sign-ins are stored only on this computer. AI assistants can't see them, but when one has Captae download something, they're used just as when you download it yourself.
这不像一个网址: This doesn't look like a web address
也读取浏览器里的登录状态: Also use sign-ins from your browser
在 Captae 里没登录的网站，用浏览器里的登录状态下载。读 Chrome 会: For sites you haven't signed in to in Captae, download with your browser's sign-in. Chrome shows a Keychain prompt; Safari needs “Full Disk Access” in System Settings. For YouTube, it's still only used when needed
在 Captae 里没登录的网站，用浏览器里的登录状态下载。Windows 上的: For sites you haven't signed in to in Captae, download with your browser's sign-in. On Windows, Chrome and Edge can't be read (they encrypt sign-ins so only they can decrypt them), so Firefox is recommended. For YouTube, it's still only used when needed
在 Captae 里没登录的网站，用浏览器里的登录状态下载。读 Chrome 这: For sites you haven't signed in to in Captae, download with your browser's sign-in. Chrome and similar browsers are decrypted with your system keyring (GNOME Keyring / KWallet). For YouTube, it's still only used when needed
跟随系统：系统用的是自动代理配置（PAC），Captae 按直连处理: Using system settings: the system uses automatic proxy configuration (PAC), which Captae treats as a direct connection
跟随系统：系统里没有设代理: Using system settings: no proxy is set
要写成 协议://地址:端口，比如 http://127.0.0.1:7890: Use the form protocol://address:port, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890
没找到下载组件，重新安装 Captae 可以修好: Download components not found. Reinstalling Captae fixes this
用的是你在设置里指定的 yt-dlp，不会自动更新: Using the yt-dlp set in your settings, which doesn't update automatically
网站改版以后，要新版的下载引擎才读得到视频: When sites change, a newer download engine is needed to read their videos
之后的下载都用新版本: New downloads will use the new version
网站改版后旧版本会读不到视频。每天查一次，核对官方签名后才换，新版出问题会自动换: After sites change, older versions can't read videos. Checks once a day, switches only after verifying the official signature, and goes back to the old version if the new one has problems
可以用 · 在这台电脑上识别，不上传: Ready · Runs on this computer, nothing is uploaded
给没有字幕的视频生成字幕 · 要下载 {size}: Creates subtitles for videos that don't have them · {size} to download
填一个 OpenAI 兼容的接口，本地的 Ollama 也可以: Enter an OpenAI-compatible API. A local Ollama works too
Claude、Cursor 等可以帮你下载和找素材: Claude, Cursor and others can download and search your Library for you
再看一遍第一次打开时的介绍，侧栏的上手清单也会回来: See the intro from the first launch again. The Getting started list comes back to the sidebar too
用手机上的 Captae 把链接发到这台电脑下载、看进度、取下载好的文件。只在手: Use Captae on your phone to send links to this computer, watch progress and get finished files. Works only when the phone and the computer are on the same Wi-Fi.
让手机连接这台电脑: Let phones connect to this computer
打开以后，配对过的手机能在同一个 Wi-Fi 下加下载、暂停和继续。手机改不了设: Paired phones on the same Wi-Fi can add, pause and resume downloads. Phones can’t change settings or delete anything from the library
这台手机要重新配对才能连接: This phone needs to pair again to connect
用手机扫这个二维码: Scan this QR code with your phone
在手机上打开 Captae › 管理电脑 › 添加电脑: On your phone, open Captae › Manage Computers › Add Computer
或者在手机上输入配对码: Or enter this pairing code on your phone
配对码输错 5 次，已经作废。二维码还能用，也可以换一个: The code was entered wrong 5 times and no longer works. The QR code still works, or get a new one
如果 macOS 问要不要允许 Captae 接受传入连接，选允许，手机才连得上: If macOS asks whether to allow Captae to accept incoming connections, choose Allow so your phone can connect
{version} 已下载好，上次没装成：{error}: {version} is downloaded. The last install failed: {error}
{version} 已下载好，重新打开就是新版: {version} is downloaded. Relaunch to use it
有新版本 {version} · 上次没更新成：{error}: Version {version} is available · The last update failed: {error}
有新版本时在后台下载好，点「重新打开」装上（要输入密码）。只连接 GitHub: Downloads new versions in the background. Click “Relaunch” to install (you'll be asked for your password). Only contacts GitHub to check the version and sends no personal information
有新版本时在后台下载好，下次打开 Captae 就是新版。只连接 GitHub: Downloads new versions in the background, so the next time you open Captae it's up to date. Only contacts GitHub to check the version and sends no personal information
